designs.name: Floral Border
designs.notes:
Align the border with the saree edge, leaving a 12 mm margin. Use two layers of 40 gsm tear-away backing. Needle 12 is the fabric-attachment (Kapda) needle.

Run the outline on a scrap piece before starting the full batch. Match metallic-thread tension at the machine.

noteLog.text: Sample setup checked. Reduce speed for metallic-thread sections if thread breakage occurs.

homeSet.notes: Front border run. Keep the fabric grain parallel to the X axis. Verify frame clearance before stitching.

designs.name: Geometric Cap Patch
designs.notes:
Use a cap driver and one layer of firm cut-away backing. Start from the center and work outward. The reference patch is centered above the visor.

Use the machine trace function to confirm clearance on the curved cap frame.

homeSet.notes: Center seam at X = 0. Keep the lower stitch line clear of the visor. Cap-driver working area may differ from hoop size.

designs.name: Paisley Dupatta
designs.notes:
Float the silk over a lightweight stabilizer. Do not stretch the weave while hooping. Check the paisley tips for puckering after the first repeat.

Kapda needle 10 should match the selected fabric shade. Test every new fabric lot.

homeSet.notes: Mark the motif repeat before mounting. Leave 15 mm clearance from the finished hem.
